name: prism
description: Search, synthesize, and organize source-backed knowledge in authorized Prism Projects.

interface.longDescription: Prism helps people retrieve source-backed context from private Projects and save durable research, files, notes, and visual artifacts through authorized AI workflows.
capabilities: Search authorized Projects and saved sources
Build cited context from files, links, and notes
Ask a Project Agent for bounded evidence synthesis
Capture research updates with review-first changes
Create private tables, charts, documents, and presentations
Review Project status, jobs, and knowledge health
defaultPrompt: Find the strongest evidence in my Project about our current hypothesis and cite the saved sources.
Summarize what changed in my Project this week, separating new evidence, confirmations, and open questions.
Create a private table in my Project comparing the options, tradeoffs, and next steps in my saved research.

positive.description: Orient to authorized Projects. Setup: connect a dedicated reviewer account with access to the fictional Atlas Launch Project, knowledge:read and the write/run scopes needed by this case. Its saved Customer interview synthesis.md, Reliability review.pdf, Market landscape.html and Launch calendar notes.md must be indexed. Resolve Project names to returned identifiers; never guess identifiers.
positive.prompt: Show me the Projects I can use in Prism and how to find evidence about the Atlas launch decision.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_prism_workspace_context. List only returned authorized Projects and identify Atlas Launch if returned. Give routing guidance without exposing inaccessible Projects or source bodies.

positive.description: Retrieve and cite saved launch evidence. Setup: connect a dedicated reviewer account with access to the fictional Atlas Launch Project, knowledge:read and the write/run scopes needed by this case. Its saved Customer interview synthesis.md, Reliability review.pdf, Market landscape.html and Launch calendar notes.md must be indexed. Resolve Project names to returned identifiers; never guess identifiers.
positive.prompt: Find evidence in my Atlas Launch Project about customer urgency and the remaining reliability risks, and cite the saved sources.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_library directly with the authorized Atlas Launch Project and query. Return the relevant source-backed matches and preserve source references without changing Project content.

positive.description: Run bounded Project Agent synthesis. Setup: connect a dedicated reviewer account with access to the fictional Atlas Launch Project, knowledge:read and the write/run scopes needed by this case. Its saved Customer interview synthesis.md, Reliability review.pdf, Market landscape.html and Launch calendar notes.md must be indexed. Resolve Project names to returned identifiers; never guess identifiers. Grant threads:read, threads:write and threads:run for this case.
positive.prompt: Ask the Project Agent in my Atlas Launch Project whether to keep the original launch date or delay one week, using the saved customer interviews and reliability review.
positive.expected_behavior: Check get_project_agent_availability for the resolved Project, start one ask_project_agent run with that folderId and this question, and use get_project_agent_run at its returned polling cadence when needed. Report an actual completed result with accessible citations, or truthfully report a queued, failed, unavailable or still-running result. Do not browse, edit the Project or invent completion.

positive.description: Create a private table artifact with complete prompt context. Setup: connect a dedicated reviewer account with access to the fictional Atlas Launch Project, knowledge:read and the write/run scopes needed by this case. Its saved Customer interview synthesis.md, Reliability review.pdf, Market landscape.html and Launch calendar notes.md must be indexed. Resolve Project names to returned identifiers; never guess identifiers. Grant library:write.
positive.prompt: Create a private table in my Atlas Launch Project comparing these options: keep the original date with open rollback and support tasks; delay one week to finish rollback verification, the support runbook and migration guidance; run early access for the three customers willing to join once the rollback plan is published. Include tradeoffs and next steps.
positive.expected_behavior: Call create_artifact with artifactType table and destination type library, using the resolved Atlas Launch folderId. Include the three supplied options, tradeoffs and next steps. Return the actual new artifact identifier and Prism link, with private visibility and no public publishing.

positive.description: Save and index a real host-provided PDF. Setup: connect a dedicated reviewer account with access to the fictional Atlas Launch Project, knowledge:read and the write/run scopes needed by this case. Its saved Customer interview synthesis.md, Reliability review.pdf, Market landscape.html and Launch calendar notes.md must be indexed. Resolve Project names to returned identifiers; never guess identifiers. Attach the linked public dummy PDF in the host and grant library:write.
positive.prompt: Save the attached PDF to my Atlas Launch Project as a research report and make it searchable.
positive.expected_behavior: Use upload_library_attachment with the resolved Atlas Launch Project, filename, application/pdf MIME type and the actual host file object with its temporary HTTPS download_url. Return the saved private source identifier and truthful import/indexing state. Do not invent an attachment URL, accept a sandbox path, or claim search readiness before indexing completes.

negative.description: Do not use Prism for an unrelated public-web lookup. Expected: The plugin should not be invoked because weather lookup is outside Prism's saved-knowledge workflows. Do not invoke any Prism tools. Explain the unsupported action or use a relevant host capability if available.
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Boston tomorrow?

negative.description: Do not place or authorize financial trades. Expected: The plugin should not be invoked to place a trade because Prism cannot connect to a brokerage or execute transactions. Do not invoke any Prism tools. Explain the unsupported action or use a relevant host capability if available.
negative.prompt: Buy 100 shares of AAPL in my brokerage account now.

negative.description: Do not send outbound email. Expected: The plugin should not send email because Prism supports inbound research organization but no outbound email action. Do not invoke any Prism tools. Explain the unsupported action or use a relevant host capability if available.
negative.prompt: Email the project update to everyone on my team.

publication.release_notes: Correct review information to exactly five positive and three negative test cases. Preserve direct MCP operation instructions, scoped access, and preview/commit workflows.
